name: framepack
description: A lightweight HyperFrames creative workbench for assets, prompts, composition, and iteration.
readme:
# Framepack

Framepack is an agent-native HyperFrames and Remotion video workbench. It turns rough user ideas, assets, and fuzzy taste words into a professional video plan that Codex or Claude Code can execute.

中文：Framepack 可以把“更商务一点、节奏更快、字大一点、动画多一点、像这个参考视频”这类普通表达，翻译成素材说明、用户摘要、风格方向、视频结构、模板路线、动效语言、composition 方案和迭代记录。

Quick start:

```bash
npm install framepack
npx framepack create --idea "A premium launch video" --assets ./assets --output-dir ./out --project-name launch-video
npx framepack workbench brief --project-dir ./out/launch-video
```

Read `FRAMEPACK.md` and `HUMAN.md` first. `HUMAN.md` is the plain-language user summary: current progress, video structure, next decision, and technology explanation.

Full docs: https://github.com/ARTHUR-BBU/framepack
